name: fdcd-smart-active-session-panel
description:
A side panel in the Claude desktop app listing the sessions active in the last days (1 to 7, your choice) as cards: a status stripe (working, asking, done), folder colors, last reply, model, context use, background tasks and pins. Click a card to open that session; + opens a new one. Shows the account's usage limits.
By FutaraDragon + Claude Derg

autoOpen.title: Open the panel in every new session
autoOpen.description: On: the Smart Active Sessions panel opens by itself when a session starts. Off: open it with /fdcd-smart-active-session-panel.
